expectations.text: Flags that the SlackClient port leaks the vendor SDK: it imports @slack/web-api types into vendor/shared and its method signatures are in Slack's vocabulary rather than domain terms
expectations.evidence: Finding 1 (CRITICAL) 'SlackClient is a wrapper, not a port': names the @slack/web-api type imports and the 1:1 SDK method mapping; cites rule 2 + anti-pattern 5 and the decision-tree 'if the interface mentions the vendor it is not a port' line.

expectations.text: Flags that ReviewsService instantiates `new SlackWebApiClient()` directly instead of depending on the SlackClient interface injected via the container
expectations.evidence: Finding 3 (CRITICAL): quotes the adapters/slack import and `new SlackWebApiClient()`; cites the service.ts -> adapters ban and rule 4; recommends constructor injection of the port.

expectations.text: Flags that the adapter reads the token from process.env instead of SecretsProvider (and/or constructs the client eagerly instead of lazily)
expectations.evidence: Finding 5 (MEDIUM): quotes `new WebClient(process.env.SLACK_BOT_TOKEN)`; cites stack-rules 'adapters constructed lazily and resolved through SecretsProvider'.

expectations.text: Recommends defining the port in domain vocabulary and wiring the adapter through platform/container.ts + ContainerOverrides
expectations.evidence: Finding 1 fix gives a domain-named ReviewNotifier interface; Finding 4 (HIGH) is specifically 'No composition-root wiring, no ContainerOverrides entry' with the fix to construct lazily in container.ts and add a notifier field to ContainerOverrides.

expectations.text: Does not invent violations that are not present (no more than one clearly-wrong extra finding)
expectations.evidence: The one extra (Finding 2: port belongs in server/src/ports/ not vendor/shared because it is browser-bundled) is correct and repo-specific. 'What is fine' section included.

notes: Skill run uniquely nails the vendor/shared vs src/ports/ distinction with the browser-bundle rationale, and ties findings to the anti-patterns review checklist (ContainerOverrides).
